product.name: Photography Website Builder and Hosting
product.description: A platform for photographers to create, edit, and host professional websites showcasing their portfolios and services with customizable templates and SEO features.

product.name: Booking System
product.description: An integrated system that manages client bookings, payments, contracts, questionnaires, and scheduling for photography services.

product.name: AI-Powered Blogging Tool
product.description: A blogging feature that uses AI to generate SEO-optimized content for photographers to maintain engaging blogs easily.

product.name: Gallery Storage and Delivery
product.description: A service offering cloud storage and client delivery of photography galleries with options for large storage capacities.

product.name: Pro Setup Website Service
product.description: A professional service where Focal designs and builds a custom photography website including SEO, booking system setup, and content creation.

product.name: Focal Ignite Marketing Program
product.description: A four-month marketing program managing paid ads and client communications to increase wedding photography bookings.
